description:
Start a PowerPoint presentation built by Claude (POST /api/v1/presentations). Paid by actual usage.

The balance is charged when the agent finishes each turn; a turn that ends with no result is refunded. With too
little money on the balance the answer is 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE and nothing is started.

This is a long task of several minutes: the answer comes at once with an id and status running. Do not wait
for it in this call; fetch the result with get_presentation until status is awaiting_input (a turn is done)
or failed. Needs brief (the topic, audience, goal and facts to use). tier is fast by default (Claude Sonnet 5.5
with an Opus 5.5 advisor) or pro (Claude Opus 5.5 for the whole deck, costs more): use pro only when the user
asks for the best quality or the chat model is Claude Opus. Optional title and file_urls (up to 5 public HTTPS
links to samples or sources: PPTX, PDF, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, MD, CSV, PNG, JPG, up to 25 MiB each and 45 MiB
together; the server downloads them). A file the user gave you instead of a link is uploaded first with
upload_media (a document up to 10 MiB here), and the url it returns goes into file_urls. Run
estimate_presentation first when the user asks the price. If the result has promo_free true the deck was free
for this user (say so; list_cost_rub is what it would have cost). Reuse
idempotency_key on a retry after a timeout so that one deck is not started twice. Tell the user the deck takes
a few minutes.
name: create_presentation
